oneOf.description: No aggregation; the value is used as it arrives.

alias.description: An optional new name for the result.

oneOf.description: Exactly one row on each side.

Channel.description: One field placed on one shelf.

agg.description: How to aggregate it. Dimensions normally use [`Agg::None`].

scale.description: The scale to use, when the worksheet defines several.

title.description: A title that overrides the field name for this worksheet.

ChartElement.description: A worksheet placed in a report.

title.description: A title for this placement, overriding the worksheet name.

worksheet.description: The worksheet this element displays. The values come from here, live.

id.description: Identifier of this column, unique within its table.

name.description: The name as the source presents it.

Connection.description:
A connection to a data source.

A connection never carries a secret. File paths and host names are stored so the workbook can
reopen its sources; passwords and keys live in the operating system keychain, or in the hosted
credential vault for Pro accounts, and are referenced out of band.

location.description: A path or a host-and-database descriptor. Never a secret.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the data pane.

options.description: Source-specific settings, such as a sheet name or a schema.

read_only.description: Whether the user asked for this connection to be read-only.

ConnectionId.description: Identifies a connection to a data source.

ConnectionKind.description: The kinds of source the application can read.

oneOf.description: A JSON or newline-delimited JSON file.

CrossFilter.description: Which direction filters propagate across a relationship.

DataModel.description: A semantic model: the tables, fields and relationships a workbook analyses.

tables.description: The tables this model draws from.

DataType.description:
The type of a value as understood by the application.

This is intentionally a small set. Types that a source reports but the application cannot use
are mapped to [`DataType::Unknown`] rather than rejected, so that a model can be partially
built from an unfamiliar source.

oneOf.description: A number with a fractional part.
A calendar date without a time.
A date with a time and, usually, a time zone.
A type the application could not classify.

Element.description: One positioned item in a report.

frame.description: Where it sits and how large it is.

ElementId.description: Identifies an element inside a report.

oneOf.description: A chart, referenced from a worksheet.

Encoding.description:
The shelves of a worksheet.

Any non-aggregated channel becomes part of the grouping. The planner derives the `GROUP BY`
from this structure rather than from a hand-written list, so the chart and the query cannot
disagree.

detail.description: Fields that split marks without encoding a visual property.

text.description: The text of a label or a KPI tile.

x2.description: The end of a horizontal range, for bars and areas.

y2.description: The end of a vertical range.

Field.description: A field exposed to worksheets: a column, or a calculation over columns.

description.description: A short explanation, shown in tooltips and offered to external agents through MCP.

folder.description: The folder the field is shown under in the data pane, if any.

hidden.description: Whether the field is hidden from the data pane.

name.description: The name shown to the user; may differ from the column name.

role.description: Whether the field groups or aggregates.

table.description: The table this field belongs to.

FieldFormat.description: How a field's values are rendered.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code, or a symbol, when the value is money.

oneOf.description: A date or timestamp format, using the application's pattern syntax.

max_chars.description: Truncate display at this many characters, when set.

FieldId.description: Identifies a field exposed by a model, which may be a column or a calculation.

FieldSource.description: Where a field's values come from.

oneOf.description: A straight reference to a column.
A calculated expression, owned by the calculation language.

expression.description: The expression source, parsed and typed by the calculation crate.

Filter.description: A predicate applied to a worksheet before aggregation.

values.description:
The comparison values. Interpretation depends on [`FilterOp`]: none for null tests, one
for comparison, two for `between`, many for `in` and `not_in`.

FilterOp.description: How a filter compares a field to its values.

oneOf.description: Not equal to the single value.
Less than or equal to the single value.
Greater than or equal to the single value.
Between the first and second values, inclusive.
Is not null. Takes no values.

Mark.description: The shape drawn for each group of values.

oneOf.description: An arc, used by pie and donut charts.
A donut: an arc with a hole in the middle.
A table of the result's columns and rows.

Orientation.description: Which way a print page faces.

Overrides.description:
Presentation overrides applied to one chart in one report.

Every field is optional and only ever affects appearance. Anything that changes the numbers
belongs to the worksheet, not here.

background.description: A background colour, as a CSS colour string.

border.description: Whether to draw a border around the element.

show_title.description: Whether to draw the chart title.

PageSetup.description: Everything needed to lay a report out on paper.

PageSize.description: The paper size of a print report.

Rect.description: A rectangle in points, with the origin at the top left.

cardinality.description: How rows on each side correspond.

RelationshipId.description: Identifies a relationship between two tables.

Report.description: A composed document built from worksheets.

canvas.description: The drawing surface for screen reports.

name.description: Name shown in the report list and as the document title.

target.description: Whether this is a screen or print document.

theme.description: The theme name, resolved against the workbook theme.

ReportId.description: Identifies a report, which composes worksheets into a document.

ReportTarget.description: What a report is designed for.

oneOf.description: A screen document that scales to the window.
A paginated document intended for paper or PDF.

Role.description: How a field participates in analysis.

oneOf.description: A field used to group, filter or label: something you slice by.
A field used in aggregation: something you measure.

Scalar.description: A literal value used by a filter or a parameter.

ScaleKind.description: How a numeric or temporal axis is mapped.

oneOf.description: Discrete with a band per category.
Discrete with a point per category.

nice.description: Whether to extend the domain to round numbers.

palette.description: A palette name, for colour scales.

agg.description: The aggregation to apply first, when sorting an aggregated result.

name.description: The name as the source presents it.

TableId.description: Identifies a table inside a model.

TextAlign.description: How text is aligned inside its frame.

style.description: A named text style from the report theme.

font_family.description: The font family for body text and axes.

palette.description: Categorical colours, as CSS colour strings, in order of use.

oneOf.description: A calculated expression evaluated over the rows.

alias.description: The field id the result is exposed as.

expression.description: The expression, owned by the calculation language.

alias.description: The field id the result is exposed as.

oneOf.description: A row limit, applied after sorting.

kind.description: Whether offsets count rows or values.

start.description: Offset of the first row, negative for preceding.

WindowFunction.description: The function applied across a window.

oneOf.description: Position of the row in the partition.

frame.description: The frame, when the function is frame-sensitive.

partition.description: The fields that define each group the window restarts over.

created.description: When the workbook was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Informational only.

description.description: An optional description, shown in the launcher.

modified.description: When the workbook was last saved, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Informational only.

description.description: A note for the author, not shown in reports.

limit.description: A row limit applied after sorting.

name.description: The tab label and the title used in reports unless overridden.
